label: Workshop 3
title: Small task models behind parity gates
summary: Train a small model to take over one hosted agent role, the PersonaDesk router, and prove it with a hash-locked parity gate that every independent training run must pass. The judge and the controller are planned next.
hardware: A 10 GB NVIDIA GPU (light tier) or a DGX Spark; data, baseline and tests run on CPU

prompts.label: What is a parity gate?
prompts.prompt: Workshop 3 uses a hash-locked parity gate before a small model may replace a hosted model for the router role. Explain what the gate checks, why it is hash-locked, and why every independent training run must pass.
